entry.title: Devín Castle

terrainReference.basis: Standard viewer PMTiles sample; reconstructed floors.

entry.note: Inspected aerial picture confirms roofless upper ruins on the pale cliff, lower irregular curtains, ruined palaces, middle court and small separate Maiden Tower on a spur. Retained east/south mapped wall traces and standard viewer PMTiles set approximate location, scale and orientation. The derivative omits the broad grass terrain patch, uses current PMTiles for architectural footings and shifts the old134.99m study datum into the170.02671087466376m PMTiles anchor datum. The bounded pale upper cliff and Maiden Tower spur remain explicit architectural landscape proxies; host PMTiles supplies surrounding ground. Anchor 16.979973665,48.17314752; heading 0; standard PMTiles datum 170.02671087466376m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
